title: Locker Rental: prepayment, auto-renewal and promotional discount terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, the discount available for prepaying the rental in a lump sum, the lengths a prepayment may cover, whether the rental may auto-renew at term end and the discount applied to an auto-renewed rental, the discount applied during promotional periods, and the discount available when the rental is bundled with an active corporate wellness enrollment. These are reference values fixed per tier; no separate handling rule governs their application beyond the value itself.

## Prepayment, auto-renewal and promotional discount table
| Tier | Prepay discount | Prepay term options (months) | Auto-renew available | Auto-renew discount | Seasonal promo discount | Corporate wellness discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | 5 percent | 6, 12 | Yes | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Medium Locker | 5 percent | 6, 12 | Yes | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Large Locker | 8 percent | 6, 12 | Yes | 5 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | 10 percent | 3, 6, 12 | Yes | 5 percent | 0 percent | 5 percent |
| Day-Use Locker | 0 percent | none offered | No | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| VIP Locker Suite | 12 percent | 3, 6, 12 | Yes | 8 percent | 0 percent | 10 percent |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- Which tier offers the largest prepayment discount, and at what percentage? The VIP Locker Suite, at twelve percent.
- May a Day-Use Locker rental auto-renew? No; auto-renewal is not available for this tier.
- What prepayment lengths may a Premium Climate-Controlled Locker member choose from? Three, six, or twelve months.
- Is a corporate wellness discount available on a Small Locker rental? No; the corporate wellness discount fixed for this tier is zero percent.
- Is any seasonal promotional discount currently fixed for any tier? No; the seasonal promotional discount is fixed at zero percent for every tier.
